title: Advanced Darts Game with Scoring System
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an advanced 3D darts game using Three.js and GLTFLoader.

## Scene Setup
- Set up a Three.js scene with a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 1.5, 4) looking toward the origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 1.0.
- Use a dark green background color (#1a3a1a).
- Load the 3D model 'BrainStem.glb' using GLTFLoader. Scale it to 0.005 and position it at (-2.5, 0.5, -1) as a decorative trophy/mascot on a small pedestal (a BoxGeometry pedestal 0.5x0.5x0.5 at (-2.5, 0.25, -1)).

## Dartboard
- Create a circular dartboard at position (0, 1.5, -2) facing the camera (rotated so its face is toward +Z).
- The dartboard is a CylinderGeometry (radius 0.6, height 0.05) rotated 90 degrees on X to face the player.
- Add concentric ring visuals using RingGeometry overlaid on the board:
  - Bullseye (center): radius 0-0.04, color red, worth 50 points
  - Bull (inner ring): radius 0.04-0.1, color green, worth 25 points
  - Triple ring: radius 0.25-0.30, color red, worth 3x the sector value
  - Double ring: radius 0.52-0.58, color red, worth 2x the sector value
  - Outer regions: alternating black/white sectors worth base sector values
- For simplicity, calculate score based on distance from center:
  - distance < 0.04: 50 (Bullseye)
  - distance < 0.10: 25 (Bull)
  - distance < 0.25: 20 (Inner single)
  - distance < 0.30: 60 (Triple)
  - distance < 0.52: 15 (Outer single)
  - distance < 0.58: 30 (Double)
  - distance > 0.58: 0 (Miss)

## Dart Mechanics
- Create darts as small ConeGeometry (radius 0.015, height 0.15) colored yellow with a small red tail.
- The player has 3 darts per round. Show a crosshair (a small '+' shaped sprite or CSS overlay) that follows mouse movement mapped onto the dartboard plane.
- When the user clicks on the canvas, throw a dart toward the crosshair position on the board.
- Animate the dart flying from camera position (0, 1.5, 4) to the target on the board over 0.4 seconds with a slight arc (parabolic Y offset peaking 0.3 above the line).
- Add slight random scatter: offset the final position by random(-0.03, 0.03) in both X and Y to simulate imprecision.
- The dart should embed into the board (stick out slightly).

## Scoring & Game State
- The game is played in rounds. Each round has 3 darts.
- Total game is 3 rounds (9 darts total).
- Track: current round (1-3), darts remaining in round (3,2,1,0), total score, round score, last throw score.
- After 3 darts in a round, show a 'Next Round' button. After round 3, show 'Game Over' with final score and a 'New Game' button.

## HUD / UI
- Display a HUD overlay (HTML div) at the top showing: Round number, Darts remaining, Round Score, Total Score.
- Style the HUD with a semi-transparent dark background, white text, font-size 18px.
- 'Next Round' button appears centered below the HUD after all 3 darts are thrown.
- 'New Game' button appears at game over.
- Display the last throw's score as a floating text near the dart impact for 1.5 seconds.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- currentRound: number (1-3)
- dartsRemaining: number (0-3)
- roundScore: number
- totalScore: number
- lastThrowScore: number
- gameOver: boolean
- dartsOnBoard: number (total darts currently stuck in board)
- modelLoaded: boolean (true when BrainStem model loads)
- dartPositions: array of {x, y, z} for each dart on the board
- phase: 'aiming' | 'throwing' | 'roundEnd' | 'gameOver'

## Interactions
- Mouse move: updates crosshair position on the dartboard plane
- Left click: throws a dart (only when phase is 'aiming' and dartsRemaining > 0)
- 'Next Round' button: advances to next round, clears darts from board, resets dartsRemaining to 3
- 'New Game' button: resets everything
- Press 'R' key: same as New Game button (reset)

## Additional Details
- Darts should cast shadows. Enable shadow mapping on the renderer.
- Add a slight camera shake (0.01 amplitude, 0.1s duration) when a dart hits the board.
- The BrainStem trophy model should slowly rotate on its Y axis (0.5 rad/s).
physics_constraints: Darts follow a parabolic arc from camera to board over 0.4s. Random scatter of ±0.03 units applied to landing position. Score is determined by radial distance from board center. Dart positions must remain within board radius (0.6) or count as miss.
